title: Mediterranean Stuffed Peppers
summary:
Prep: 10 minutes | Cook: 1hr 15 minutes | Total: 1hr 25 minutes
Yield: 8 servings | Serving Size: 1/2 stuffed pepper

Ingredients
• 2 tsp finely crushed rosemary leaves
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp oregano
• 1/2 tsp salt
• 1 pound lean ground beef
• 1 can (14 ounces) no salt added tomato sauce
• 1/4 cup toasted slivered almonds
• 1 cup cooked brown rice
• 1 egg, beaten
• 4 medium bell peppers
• 1/2 cup crumbled reduced fat feta cheese

Directions
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Cook ground beef in large skillet on medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes or until no longer pink, stirring occasionally to break up meat. Drain fat. Season with rosemary, cinnamon, oregano and salt.
3. Stir in tomato sauce and almonds. Bring to a boil. Remove from heat. Add rice and egg; mix well.
4. Cut bell peppers in half, lengthwise. Remove stem and seeds.
5. Arrange bell pepper halves, cut-side up, in 13x9-inch baking dish. Spoon beef mixture evenly into bell pepper halves. Pour 1/4 cup water into baking dish. Cover with foil.
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until bell peppers are tender.
7. Sprinkle filling with feta cheese. Bake, uncovered, 12 to 15 minutes longer or until cheese is lightly browned.

Nutrition Facts Per Serving: Calories: 225 | Carbohydrates: 24.6g | Protein: 16.9g | Fat: 6.8g | Saturated Fat: 2.3g | Fiber: 3.1g | Sodium: 290mg

Adapted from www.mccormick.com | Submitted by Kristine Van Workum, RD For more recipes, please visit https://www.nutrition.va.gov

By Suneel Kumar The traditional oversight of supply chains relies heavily on calendar-driven audits and static, pass/fail checklists.
